_about: Phase 2 (PostgreSQL pipeline) success criteria, pre-registered 2026-11-21 before the first load. Judged by mdqc.verify_phase2. Anything decided after the first load is labelled post hoc in docs/PIPELINE.md.

design.database: PostgreSQL 17, database mdqc, login mdqc_app (created by mdqc.db_setup), schema core
design.tables: dim_product_code, dim_manufacturer, dim_date, fact_report, report_device, report_problem, report_patient_problem, report_text, fact_recall, report_recall_link, quarantine, load_run
design.grain: fact_report: one row per MAUDE report (mdr_report_key) under its scope product code; fact_recall: one row per recall record (product_res_number)
design.load: one transaction per run: truncate core tables, COPY clean rows, write quarantine and a load_run row with the raw-file checksums; re-running gives the same table contents
design.privacy: never loaded: every manufacturer_contact_* field, patient age, sex, weight, race and ethnicity. Loaded patient information is limited to FDA patient-problem terms (not identifying). Narratives are loaded (needed for the assistant) as FDA redacted them.

report_quarantine.R1: mdr_report_key missing, or seen before in the same file
report_quarantine.R2: date_received not a valid YYYYMMDD date or outside 2022-01-01..2024-12-31
report_quarantine.R3: no device entry carries the scope product code
report_quarantine.R4: event_type not one of Malfunction, Injury, Death, Other, or blank (blank is loaded as 'Not provided')

rules.report_flags_not_quarantine: date_of_event invalid -> NULL with flag 'invalid'; event after receipt -> kept with flag 'after_received'

recall_quarantine.Q2: event_date_initiated invalid and not repairable by the repair rule

rules.recall_date_repair: if the initiation year is before 1976 and event_date_posted is valid: use the posted year with the original month and day; if that date is after the posted date use the year before; mark initiated_date_repaired = true. Expected: 1 record (JWH, '0013-11-26', posted 2013-12-13 -> 2013-11-26).
rules.manufacturer: config/manufacturer_aliases.json; the report's manufacturer is manufacturer_d_name of the first device entry with the scope product code (same as Phase 1); recalls map recalling_firm with the same rules

links.510k: report.pma_pmn_number (trimmed, upper-case) is one of the recall's k_numbers AND same product code (strong link: same cleared device family)
links.firm_window: same product code AND same parent company AND date_received between 180 days before and 365 days after the recall's initiation date (weak link: candidate context, never proof)

criteria.P1_accounted: For every raw file: rows loaded + rows quarantined = raw records (events per code, recalls per code).
criteria.P2_cell_for_cell: verify_phase2 rebuilds every loaded row of fact_report, report_device, report_problem, report_patient_problem, report_text and fact_recall from the raw files with separate code (no import of the loader) and compares all rows and columns with the database: 0 differences.
criteria.P3_privacy: No column in schema core is named like a dropped field (contact, patient age/sex/weight/race/ethnicity); no dropped-field value from a 1,000-report sample appears in any loaded text column.
criteria.P4_idempotent: Two consecutive loads give identical content fingerprints (md5 over ordered rows) for every table except load_run.
criteria.P5_planted_faults: On a copy of the fixture with one planted fault per rule (R1-R5, Q1, Q2) loaded into a separate schema, each faulty record is quarantined with the right rule and every clean record still loads.
criteria.P6_manufacturers: Every raw manufacturer/firm name maps to exactly one parent; the mapping in the database equals the verifier's own application of config/manufacturer_aliases.json.
criteria.P7_recall_dates: Invalid recall initiation dates are repaired by the registered rule or quarantined; the verifier recomputes the repaired dates.
criteria.P8_links: The verifier recomputes both link sets independently: exact equality with report_recall_link.
criteria.P9_phase1_reproduced: SQL on the database reproduces Phase 1's published numbers: reports and recalls per code, monthly counts, event types, top-10 problem terms (once per report), top manufacturer per code.
criteria.P10_ci: A CI job with a PostgreSQL service loads the fixture and runs the verifier (P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P8 on the fixture).

phase_done_when: P1-P9 pass on the full data (evidence committed), P10 green in CI, docs/PIPELINE.md generated from results, notebook 02 runs top to bottom and ends with the 'Why we did these tasks' table.
